title: Intervention drawing + visibility
description: Add a polygon/point drawing tool (terra-draw) to intervention submission, a typed land/air intervention category with server-side area caps, and client-side map visibility for drafted/proposed interventions.

dependencies.note: This track's 'published interventions visible' criterion is gated on that track landing the publishContribution/rejectContribution UI fix; this track's own scope (drawing, area caps, category, draft/proposed overlay) does not depend on it.
Blocked research spike, no product/schema decisions to reuse; the air-intervention category introduced here stays generic and must not duplicate or unblock that spike.

touches: src/lib/map/measurement.ts (export polygonArea for reuse; no behavior change)
src/lib/server/db/schema.ts (only if category becomes a first-class column, decided in Phase 1)
